# SOUP 

## Scrap Broth 

- equal parts onion/garlic:carrot:celery 
  * too much onion will make it bitter
- collect onion bits & garlic skins 
- collect scraps of carrots/celery (often have to just buy celery though b/c don't use it that much) 
- also collect scraps: 
  * mushroom 
  * lemon/citrus peels 
  * napa cabbage 
  * zucchini 
- put in freezer while collecting 

**Cooking** 

- heat oil in pot 
- add onion/garlic scrapes and saute ~10 minutes 
- add all other scrapes and saute for another ~10 minutes 
- add salt while sauteing (at least 1 tsp for each ~16 oz of total scrapes) 
- add water; fill up each container holding scrapes with water and put into pot (if have 4 16oz containers of scrapes, put 64oz of water into pot) 
- also add: bay leave and thyme 
- bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat for 90-120 minutes 
- remove from heat and let cool
- strain out scrapes and put into containers, freeze if not using within 3 days 


```{r}
#| results: asis
folder <- "soup"
files <- list.files(folder, pattern = ".qmd$")
out <- purrr::map(
  files, 
  ~knitr::knit_child(file.path(folder, .x), quiet = TRUE, envir = environment())
)
cat(unlist(out), sep = "\n")
```
